decision_rule.abandon: Any compliance/leakage/shared-state failure, legal-policy crash, silent undeclared-control acceptance, or confident effect claim for a zero-evidence operator.
decision_rule.keep_or_refine: All legal catalog policies execute; zero-evidence controls use the preregistered fallback and abstain; observed controls retain action-conditioned switching; focused and screening evidence has no hard failure.

falsifier: Reject the refinement if any catalog-legal policy still raises, if an undeclared identifier is silently accepted, if an operator with zero visible transition evidence is labeled learned, if an unseen-control rollout is non-abstaining or differs from its declared natural fallback, or if query order/update/cold rehydrate/single-state properties regress.
hypothesis: A catalog-closed switching-particle model that creates an operator for every generic public control, distinguishes treatment and check evidence, and marks zero-evidence operators as epistemic fallbacks can make every legal public policy total without fabricating a learned treatment effect or confidently recommending an unobserved control.
known_failure_addressed: EXP-037 crashed on a frozen legal public policy whose planned control was declared by the catalog but had no fitted treatment operator. The failed implementation treated missing operator evidence as a protocol violation.
minimal_complete_change: Enumerate generic catalog treatments and checks as control operators; estimate transitions only when matching visible events exist; otherwise use an explicit identity/natural switching prior with zero evidence count. Propagate an unobserved-control uncertainty flag through rollout, decode a natural-policy fallback rather than an action effect, and abstain. Do not introduce world, action, check, case, test, hidden-state, or future-specific branches.

planned_screen_config.seed_authority: published BENCHMARK_V1_SEED_REVEAL; development-only, not blind confirmation
